findings.detail: Two parallel Belief systems coexist. AdaptiveBelief (old, defined in schemas/belief_version.py) is actively used by EvolutionPipeline and BeliefLifecycleManager (evolution/). ResearchBelief (new, defined in research/beliefs/schemas.py) exists but is NOT integrated into ResearchCycleEngine.run_cycle(). The EvolutionPipeline which ResearchCycleEngine relies on for Step 8 (Evolution) uses AdaptiveBelief — meaning the production code path never touches ResearchBelief or the new BeliefEngine.

findings.detail: DailyRunner.run_today() bypasses the entire M1 data pipeline (Collector → Validator → Normalizer → FeatureEngine → StateVector). It builds MacroSnapshot directly from a user-provided dict[str, float] instead of running MacroPipeline.build_daily_macro_snapshot(). This means the DailyRunner has ZERO real data validation.

call_chain: DailyRunner ACTUAL: raw dict → MacroSnapshot (BYPASS — zero data validation)
